svg.title: On inactive links the fine slice input remains unchanged. On active links the identity is needed only where their protecting cutoffs are nonzero. Those cutoffs imply ∥u′ e∥≤8a tfield. Choose the scale delay so that 8a tfield ≤d/2. Then (PV2) implies ∥ue∥≤∥u′ e∥+ ∥pMe(ue)∥≤d, so (PV4) applies there. This proves equality of the old and new reconstructed configurations on every protected read. A cutoffproduct vanishing at the read makes the corresponding term zero. A nonzero product forces equality on its whole actual footprint. This argument proves the equality for old activities, atom words, row predictions, sector profiles and their complements individually, including the hard decisions inside them. It does not differentiate a hard decision. Writing the physical fluctuation as u = μV0 + gz, g = β−1/2 > 0, the corresponding Gaussian coordinate change is z′ = g−1{ΦM(μV0 + gz) −μV }. (PV5)
